name: Mistral AI
description: Mistral AI provider with full reasoning support: translates DeepSeek-style reasoning_content into Mistral's ThinkChunk format in both directions (JSON + SSE), keeps ThinkingBlock alive through AgentScope's OpenAI formatter, maps thinking levels to reasoning_effort, and enables prompt_cache_key for 10%-price cached input.

description_i18n.zh-CN: Mistral AI 供应商：双向翻译 reasoning_content 与 ThinkChunk（含 SSE 流式），保住被 AgentScope 丢弃的思考块，把 thinking level 映射到 reasoning_effort，并启用 prompt_cache_key 以命中 10% 计价的缓存输入。

author: hugh
